message:
I’ll never forget the time my neighbor scoffed at my weather-prep stash. "You really think we’ll get a storm that bad?" she chuckled, while I stood there with my extra flashlight batteries and non-perishables. Fast forward to that winter when we were snowed in for three days. I was sitting cozy with my hot cocoa, feeling a bit smug when she came knocking, asking if I had any extra canned soup. 

Sometimes, being prepared isn’t about being a worrywart; it’s just about having a little extra on hand for those unexpected moments. What’s your favorite tip for staying ready when nature throws a curveball? ☕
